name: kagi-websearch
description: Routes the WebSearch tool to Kagi through the kagi-search command line, with the session in browser-fetch's cookie jar.

searchCommand.title: kagi-search command
searchCommand.description: The kagi-search executable; it prints JSON hits with --json and exits non-zero with the reason on stderr.

maxResults.title: Results per search
maxResults.description: How many Kagi results a standard search returns, after domain filtering; an extended search returns all of Kagi's first page, about 25 to 35.
